en.topic_title: Hong Kong man unanimously acquitted of raping female friend at Sai Kung campsite
en.topic_summary:
A 24-year-old man has been acquitted of raping a female friend at a Sai Kung campsite three years ago, with the jury unanimously finding him not guilty.



The High Court. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Fung Cheuk-kei appeared at the High Court on Monday morning following an eight-day trial for two counts of rape before a seven-member jury – including four women and three men.



He was accused of raping a woman, known to the court as X, when they went to Sai Kung on November 10, 2023.
